insights.title: EQPT IMPORTANT DEADLINE: ROSEN, NATIONAL INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages EquipmentShare.com Inc Investors with Losses in Excess of $100K to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action - EQPT
insights.claim: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against EquipmentShare.com Inc (NASDAQ: EQPT) alleging that defendants made materially false and misleading statements regarding undisclosed related party transactions and failed to disclose material adverse facts about the company's business and financial statements. Investors who purchased EQPT securities during the IPO in January 2026 or between January 23 and June 23, 2026, may be eligible for compensation. The lead plaintiff deadline is September 21, 2026.

insights.title: מועד אחרון חשוב בנוגע ל-EQPT: רוזן, המייצג משקיעים במישור הארצי, קורא למשקיעים בחברת EquipmentShare.com Inc שספגו הפסדים העולים על 100,000 דולר לשכור ייצוג משפטי לקראת מועד אחרון חשוב בתביעה ייצוגית בניירות ערך – EQPT
insights.claim: Rosen Law Firm is urging investors in EquipmentShare.com Inc (NASDAQ: EQPT) who suffered losses exceeding $100,000 to seek legal representation before the September 21, 2026 deadline for a securities class action lawsuit. The lawsuit alleges that EquipmentShare made materially false or misleading statements in its IPO registration documents and failed to disclose undisclosed related-party transactions and inflated financial reports.

insights.title: Bragar Eagel & Squire, P.C. Reminds EquipmentShare, Inc. Investors that a Class Action Lawsuit Has Been Filed Against EquipmentShare and Encourages Investors to Contact the Firm
insights.claim: A class action lawsuit has been filed against EquipmentShare, Inc. (NASDAQ: EQPT) in the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York. The lawsuit alleges that the company made materially false and misleading statements in its January 2026 IPO registration statement and failed to disclose undisclosed related party transactions with entities owned or controlled by co-founders. Investors who purchased shares between January 23, 2026 and June 23, 2026 are eligible to participate. The deadline to apply as lead plaintiff is September 21, 2026.

insights.title: Deadline Alert: EquipmentShare.com Inc. (EQPT) Shareholders Who Lost Money Urged To Contact Glancy Prongay Wolke & Rotter LLP About Securities Fraud Lawsuit
insights.claim: EquipmentShare.com Inc. (EQPT) faces a securities fraud class action lawsuit after Umibōzu Research revealed undisclosed related-party transactions worth at least $77 million involving company founders. The allegations claim the company funneled significant fees through its OWN program to entities owned by the Schlacks family. Following the report's publication on June 24, 2026, EQPT stock declined over 34.5% from its $24.50 IPO price. The deadline to file a lead plaintiff motion is September 21, 2026.
